title: QE MCP servers fail stdio startup when launched by direct script path
description:
Expected: Codex/Codex App MCP startup should initialize both aistock-qe-experiment and aistock-qe-archive successfully and expose their FastMCP tools when the configured cwd is the AIstock repo/worktree.
Actual: Both MCP clients close during initialize. Direct reproduction shows scripts/aistock_qe_experiment_mcp_server.py and scripts/aistock_qe_archive_mcp_server.py crash before FastMCP handshake with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'scripts.aistock_mcp_common'. The direct script launch puts the scripts directory, not the repo root, on sys.path, so absolute imports from scripts.* fail.
required_verification: MCP stdio direct-script initialize/list_tools self-test for aistock-qe-experiment and aistock-qe-archive
MCP stdio module-mode initialize/list_tools self-test for aistock-qe-experiment and aistock-qe-archive
closure_requirements: Both QE MCP servers initialize successfully when launched by direct script path from config.toml/config.json style args.
Both QE MCP servers still initialize successfully with python -m scripts.<server> module args.
No production FastAPI 8001 restart, production DB write, or QE runtime execution is required for this fix.
GitHub Issue #26 and local BUG-044 registry entry are updated with fix and verification evidence.

events.note: Observed startup warning: MCP startup incomplete (failed: aistock-qe-archive, aistock-qe-experiment).
MCP client self-test with direct script args reproduced connection closed during initialize for both servers.
Module startup works: python -m scripts.aistock_qe_experiment_mcp_server exposes 22 tools and python -m scripts.aistock_qe_archive_mcp_server exposes 15 tools.
Production FastAPI port 8001 and production DB were not restarted or touched during diagnosis.

GitHub mirror manually created as https://github.com/licong01-cloud/AIstock/issues/26 because MCP live GitHub sync lacked GITHUB_REPOSITORY in its environment. Starting issue-flow fix in dedicated worktree/branch.
Manual GitHub mirror created with gh CLI after MCP sync failed because GITHUB_REPOSITORY was unavailable in MCP environment.
Added targeted QE MCP server test file and BUG-044 registry file to allowed_write_scope; recorded required verification and closure requirements.

py_compile passed for both QE MCP servers and common helper; backend/tests/test_aistock_qe_mcp_servers.py passed 13 tests; direct-script and module-mode MCP initialize/list_tools self-test passed for both servers.

Fixed in dedicated worktree F:/Dev/AIstock_worktrees/bug-044-qe-mcp-stdio-startup. Direct script and module-mode MCP initialize/list_tools self-tests passed for both QE MCP servers; pytest passed 13 tests. GitHub mirror #26 updated separately via gh CLI.
